description: Open the dataset 'BFI25.csv' located in '~/Documents/Jamovi/'. Perform a Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test comparing the Extraversion items 'E1' and 'E2' (paired variables). Enable 'Descriptives' and 'Effect Size' (Rank biserial correlation) in the analysis options. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/WilcoxonSignedRank.omv'. Finally, create a text file '~/Documents/Jamovi/wilcoxon_results.txt' containing exactly three lines with the following numeric values from your analysis: 1) The Wilcoxon W statistic, 2) The p-value, 3) The effect size.
